text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: LATENCY_P99_US-EAST for service=inference-api — p99 = 1.25s, SLO burn 0.9% over 5m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1812004321 :rotating_light:
oncall-lee: acked — looking now. Can someone confirm region scope?
maya.sre: seeing p99 spike concentrated on us-east-1a, KV cache eviction rate up. heatmap -> https://grafana.redwood/d/kv/evictions
tom-platform: checking autoscaler and sidecar queue. `kubectl top pods -n inference` looks normal but batcher queues rising.
oncall-lee: trying fallback to smaller batch size for hot route, will toggle batching config.
maya.sre: quick check -> a recent rollout to model-serving v2.3.1 landed ~8m ago, could be mem regen causing GC stalls on tokenizers.
emma-product: any customer-facing impact? I see 2 support tickets (low volume) but they mention slow responses.
jordan-cs: flagged to the customers, no major outage but UX degradation for chat flows, leaving note in CS tracker.
oncall-lee: applied temporary fallback: route inference-api/us-east -> model-quantized variant, batching_size=8 -> command: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/routes/swap -d '{"route":"inference-api","target":"quantized-v1","batch":8}'`
maya.sre: KV eviction looks correlated with a spike in hotkey writes from a partner tenant. I'm pinning a redistribution rule to evict less aggressively.
tom-platform: autoscaler temporarily bumped min_replicas from 4 -> 6 in us-east to absorb tail. Applied: `opsctl scale inference-api --region us-east --min 6`
oncall-lee: p99 dropped to ~700ms after route swap and scale. Monitoring next 10m. :thumbsup:
emma-product: opened a small customer advisory (SLA note) referencing degraded latency and mitigation steps.
jordan-cs: will follow up with affected customers, CC'ing account owners.
maya.sre: will roll back recent tokenizer change in canary if we see re-burn; collecting heap/GC traces now.
tom-platform: leaving autoscaler bump for 15m then gradually reduce if stable.
oncall-lee: moving to incident update cadence: check-ins at +5m, +15m. If p99 stays <900ms mark resolved and start RCA.
incident-bot: Alert status: acknowledged by oncall-lee. Tags: auto-escalation=off, severity=high.
